import java.util.*;

public class MaxFlowSolver {
    static final int INF = 100000000;
    static final int MAXN = 6000;

    static class MaxFlow {
        List<Integer>[] v = new ArrayList[MAXN];
        List<Integer>[] rev = new ArrayList[MAXN];
        List<Integer>[] cost = new ArrayList[MAXN];
        List<Integer>[] cap = new ArrayList[MAXN];

        int[] dist = new int[MAXN];
        int[] inq = new int[MAXN];
        int[] pre_x = new int[MAXN];
        int[] pre_i = new int[MAXN];

        public MaxFlow() {
            for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
                v[i] = new ArrayList<>();
                rev[i] = new ArrayList<>();
                cost[i] = new ArrayList<>();
                cap[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
        }

        void add_edge(int x, int y, int c, int w) {
            rev[x].add(v[y].size());
            rev[y].add(v[x].size());
            v[x].add(y);
            v[y].add(x);
            cost[x].add(w);
            cost[y].add(-w);
            cap[x].add(c);
            cap[y].add(0);
        }

        void spfa(int s) {
            Arrays.fill(dist, 0x3f3f3f3f);
            Arrays.fill(inq, 0);
            pre_x[s] = -1;
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.offer(s);
            dist[s] = 0;
            inq[s] = 1;

            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int x = q.poll();
                inq[x] = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < v[x].size(); i++) {
                    int y = v[x].get(i);
                    int nd = dist[x] + cost[x].get(i);
                    if (dist[y] > nd && cap[x].get(i) > 0) {
                        dist[y] = nd;
                        pre_x[y] = x;
                        pre_i[y] = i;
                        if (inq[y] == 0) {
                            inq[y] = 1;
                            q.offer(y);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int total_flow = 0;

        int dfs(int x, int f) {
            if (pre_x[x] == -1) return f;
            int y = x;
            x = pre_x[y];
            int i = pre_i[y];
            int j = rev[x].get(i);
            int pushed = dfs(x, Math.min(f, cap[x].get(i)));
            cap[x].set(i, cap[x].get(i) - pushed);
            cap[y].set(j, cap[y].get(j) + pushed);
            return pushed;
        }

        Pair<Integer, Integer> solve(int s, int t) {
            int ans = 0;
            int total_cost = 0;
            while (true) {
                spfa(s);
                if (dist[t] > 1000000000) break;
                int f = dfs(t, INF);
                total_cost += f * dist[t];
                ans += f;
            }
            return new Pair<>(ans, total_cost);
        }
    }

    static class Pair<U, V> {
        public final U first;
        public final V second;

        public Pair(U first, V second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }
    }

    static int node_id(int x, int t) {
        return t * 52 - 52 + x;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int s = MAXN - 1;
        int t = MAXN - 2;
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int c = sc.nextInt();
        int d = sc.nextInt();

        MaxFlow maxflow = new MaxFlow();

        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt();
            maxflow.add_edge(s, node_id(x, 1), 1, 0);
        }

        int k_copy = k;
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt();
            int y = sc.nextInt();
            for (int t = 1; t < 100; t++) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= k_copy; j++) {
                    maxflow.add_edge(node_id(x, t), node_id(y, t + 1), 1, d * (j + j - 1));
                }
            }
            // swap x and y
            int temp = x;
            x = y;
            y = temp;
            for (int t = 1; t < 100; t++) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= k_copy; j++) {
                    maxflow.add_edge(node_id(x, t), node_id(y, t + 1), 1, d * (j + j - 1));
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i < 100; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                maxflow.add_edge(node_id(j, i), node_id(j, i + 1), INF, 0);
            }
            maxflow.add_edge(node_id(1, i), t, INF, c * (i - 1));
        }

        System.out.println(maxflow.solve(s, t).second);
    }
}
